user_saw: Claude CLI announced a sub-agent’s result, then said on the next turn that the sub-agent had yet to report back.
summary: The fix carries recent completion exchanges from the saved transcript into the next authorized Claude CLI resume and includes those exchanges in the gap notice when their content is withheld.
reasoning: I checked the binding history and confirmed that preserve-state turns could keep the requester’s native Claude session binding before #168726 added a gap notice that treated any Claude CLI reply as a resume boundary. That explains why the notice missed separately recorded announcements. The older history stopped at the shallow boundary, leaving the origin of the underlying continuity failure unverified.
